mutations.name: the run-free proof read always skips
mutations.find: readPrFixProof(port, target, { now: Date.now, sleep, timeoutMs: 0 }, new AbortController().signal)
mutations.replace: Promise.resolve({ kind: "skipped" as const, reason: "no Shepherd run" })
kills: the review CLI's run-free fix-proof read reads a bug-fix PR whose fix-proof check printed a NO_REPRO line as no-repro, with no Shepherd run

mutations.name: no required checks reads as pending
mutations.find: return { state: headRunsState(await port.checkRuns(repo, head), head), source: "head-check-runs" };
kills: the review CLI's CI read reads a repo with no required checks as green once every check run at the head passed, and names that source

mutations.name: a red head run is not failing
kills: the review CLI's CI read reads a repo with no required checks as failing from its head's check runs

mutations.name: a head with no runs reads green
kills: the review CLI's CI read reads a repo with no required checks as pending from its head's check runs

mutations.name: the CLI output leaves out the CI source
kills: the review CLI's CI read reads a repo with no required checks as green once every check run at the head passed, and names that source
